finding.source_observation: The canonical UCF validator admitted an envelope with inference.executed=true and workspace.gwt_winners=[] when all other current v1 constraints and the recomputed envelope digest were satisfied.
finding.risk: An inference receipt could claim participation in the Unified Cognitive Fabric without any selected GWT workspace winner, weakening the mandatory Zero/J-Space workspace-binding contract.
finding.counterhypothesis: Winner absence is a valid state only when inference is not executed or is explicitly blocked/abstained.
finding.resolution: Require one already-valid GWT winner whenever inference.executed=true; preserve zero-winner state for nonexecuted blocked paths.

delta.host_validator: Adds EXECUTED_INFERENCE_REQUIRES_GWT_WINNER after executed is parsed; existing uniqueness/max-one/membership guards remain canonical.
delta.claycode_contract: Adds executed_inference_requires_one_gwt_winner = true without creating a second schema authority.
delta.regression: Adds one fail-closed executed/no-winner case and one permitted nonexecuted blocked/no-winner case.

policy.reason: No immutable shared macrocycle/request identifier was exposed on this surface, so the atomic experiment lease was not invented.

next_gate: Execute the focused UCF regression suite on an actually-started admitted isolated executor, then bind an exact-source emitted runtime receipt through current boot ancestry before any runtime promotion.
